rule_notes.min_coverage: Months with coverage below this are flagged low_coverage and not used (same threshold as trends.py --min-coverage).
rule_notes.outlier_z: A month is flagged outlier_suspect when the robust z-score of its deseasonalised anomaly, 0.6745 * (anomaly - median) / MAD, exceeds this in absolute value. Flag only; the value is kept.
rule_notes.max_linear_gap_months: Gaps of at most this many consecutive months are filled by linear interpolation of the anomaly; longer gaps are filled with anomaly 0 (the monthly climatology). No extrapolation before the first or after the last usable month.
rule_notes.max_fill_fraction: A series whose filled share of months (between its first and last usable month) exceeds this is not used for data mining (same as trends.py --max-missing-fraction).

From 2024-07 to 2025-06 GLDAS evapotranspiration is higher than FLDAS (about +0.08 to +0.20 mm/day through 2025-05, +0.04 in 2025-06), in the same months in which the GLDAS shortwave forcing is 15 to 32 W m-2 higher than FLDAS.

The 2001-2026 global land trend has the opposite sign in GLDAS (-0.43) and FLDAS (+0.16 kg m-2 per decade); the two series correlate at 0.08. With one comparison product it cannot be told which is closer to the truth. No clear step was found.
